segments.text:
V. 19.
He ſhall not ſtrive, nor clamour; neither ſhall any man hear his voice in the ſtreets—That is, He ſhall not be contentious, noiſy, or oſtentatious; but gentle, quiet, and lowly. We may obſerve, each Word riſes above the other, expreſſing a ſtill higher Degree of Humility and Gentleneſs.
